hypothesis: Y041 found preserving three bounded observed entries helped across all drift regimes. Determine whether the choice of three assignments (newest, oldest or temporally spread) changes post-interruption survival using identical storage capacity and reset schedule.
environment: Exact SHA256-keyed nonaliased Y037 graph: seven active motif identities, sixteen motif/cell slots, four drift regimes drift1/drift2/drift4/late_shock, eight episodes, circular radius2 and four-way collision.
selection_arms: preserve0 control: clear inactive cache at each reset
newest3: retain last 3 insertion-ordered previously observed inactive assignments
oldest3: retain first 3 insertion-ordered previously observed inactive assignments
spread3: retain first/middle/last currently cached inactive assignment without duplicate
policy: Each selection compared in paired write-matched sham vs full legal preference read. At reset clear active/previous-assignment runtime state in all arms; evaluator-only history retained solely for churn accounting. No extra cache, auxiliary time counters, or future geometry used.
primary: Across 4 regimes x4 preservation arms report heldout sham-minus-retained churn, per-seed and episode savings, legal preference reads, identical cache writes/keys across each sham/full pair and independent Hall7 matching.
classification: RECENCY_PRIORITY if newest3 savings exceed oldest3 in at least 3 regimes and its total exceeds oldest3 by>=8; POSITIONAL_DIVERSITY if spread3 exceeds newest3 in at least 3 regimes and aggregate by>=8; MIXED otherwise. Preserve all harmful cases.
controls: Exact Y041 source/prereg provenance, no post-result selection, unseen dev/heldout cohorts
No oracle, 7 active and <=9 retained within 16 original slots, unchanged full matching budget
First-use original archive before a full pytest regression
claim_limit: Synthetic memory-preservation choice, no learned semantic consolidation or biological regeneration.
